scoring_justification: Recompute failure strain from raw force-strain curves; MLG strain at peak force compared to paper-reported ~10% tolerance band and GH max strain compared to >1200% threshold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold strain bands: MLG failure ~10% (tolerance 8-12%), GH max strain exceeding 1200%.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure S4c,d and accompanying text: MLG failure at about 10%; GH strain exceeding 1200%.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper; tolerances chosen to reflect a reasonable re-run spread around 10%.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are explicitly reported in the paper; no fabrication.

outputs.description: Raw force‑strain and strain energy‑strain data for MLG; the checker recomputes the failure strain from this file.

output_contract.notes: The primary scoring is recomputed from the CSV files; the summary JSON is an auxiliary check. All files must be placed under /app/outputs.
